name: kyber1024-decapsulate
description: KEM type 0x08. Key pair generated by the oracle; ciphertext produced by the oracle while it built a session (read from its session state). shared_secret was computed by the generator with a CRYSTALS-Kyber round-3 (v3.02) Kyber1024 decapsulation of the ciphertext without its type byte, and confirmed: PQXDH with this value reproduces the chain key the oracle derived. The FIPS 203 ML-KEM-1024 decapsulation of the same bytes is shown only for contrast; it does NOT reproduce the oracle chain key.
